title: Yesterday's Code, Today's Dependencies: How Dependency Selection Shapes PHP Migration Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Migration benchmarks need projects whose tests pass before migration begins. Yet an old project can behave differently without any change to its code. Reinstalling it today may introduce newer libraries, changing both its initial test results and the failures observed during migration.   We investigate this effect in PHP 7.4-to-8.3 migration. Using unchanged project source and saved package records, we compare two dependency policies. Modern selection allows all versions in the snapshot, while release-date selection allows only versions published by the project's release date. With Composer 2 fixed, release-date selection improves the PHP 7.4 pass rate by 7.1 pp across 3,660 releases. A separate comparison against committed locks shows that it also recovers recorded dependency versions more closely than modern selection.   The choice matters after migration as well. translated_title: 昨天的代码，今天的依赖：依赖选择如何塑造PHP迁移基准测试
translated_abstract: 迁移基准测试需要那些在迁移开始之前测试就能通过的项目。然而，一个旧项目即使代码没有任何更改，其表现也可能不同。今天重新安装它可能会引入更新的库，从而改变其初始测试结果以及迁移过程中观察到的失败情况。我们在PHP 7.4到8.3的迁移中研究了这种影响。使用未更改的项目源代码和保存的包记录，我们比较了两种依赖策略：现代选择允许快照中的所有版本，而发布日期选择只允许项目发布日期之前发布的版本。在固定Composer 2的情况下，发布日期选择在3,660个发布版本中将PHP 7.4的通过率提高了7.1个百分点。与已提交的锁定文件进行的单独比较表明，它比现代选择更接近地恢复了所记录的依赖版本。这一选择在迁移之后同样重要。在两种策略下都能在PHP 7.4上通过的项目中，PHP 8.3的测试结果……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，在PHP迁移基准测试中，采用发布日期依赖选择策略相比现代选择策略可将PHP 7.4测试通过率提高7.1个百分点，表明依赖版本的选择方式会显著影响迁移基准测试的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in PHP migration benchmarks, release-date dependency selection improves the PHP 7.4 pass rate by 7.1 percentage points over modern selection, demonstrating that how dependencies are chosen significantly shapes migration benchmark outcomes.
